svg.title: One GRPO step on one GB10
svg.desc: One DGX Spark GB10 package drawn in iso: a Grace CPU die with 20 Arm cores and a Blackwell GPU die, both joined to one 128 GB slab of unified LPDDR5X memory at the center. On the Grace die run the Ray head, the TrainerController and ray::RolloutExecutor actors, and the math reward. On the Blackwell die the FSDP trainer is active and the SGLang engine waits. Inside the shared slab the trainer state is the active footprint and the engine state is parked. The trainer onloads in 0.87 s, and the weight update to the engine takes 0.64 s. Below, one median step of 152.6 s to scale: rollout 47.5 s, log probabilities 23.4 s, GRPO update 77.0 s, weight update 0.64 s, and 4.2 s that the phase medians do not cover. Medians of 48 steps of a run made before we added the heat guard.
svg.text: ONE NVIDIA DGX SPARK · GB10 SUPERCHIP
LPDDR5X · 128 GB unified, one pool for both dies
ONE STEP TO SCALE · 152.6 S, MEDIAN OF 48
dashed end: median step minus the phase medians, 4.2 s. Trainer offload 0.76 s.
Medians from the run made before the heat guard.
